name: Value axes

subjectOf.text: History reveals three polar opposite sets of fundamental values that any society must integrate in order to stay stable and healthy.
subjectOf.abstract: To keep any society stable and healthy, history reveals three polar opposite sets of fundamental values that need to be integrated:
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, The Importance of Transcendental Unifying Values for Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782220

subjectOf.text: The intuition that strengthening one pole of a value pair necessarily diminishes its opposite is plainly false in any complex situation.
subjectOf.abstract: Each pair of values is in tension with its opposite. It is natural to imagine that strengthening one diminishes its opposite. But that is plainly false in any complex sit- uation.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, The Importance of Transcendental Unifying Values for Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782220
